# React Gotchas

> Known React patterns that cause infinite loops, memory leaks, or silent state bugs. Load all HIGH entries before writing React components.

## Entries

- [useEffect infinite loop when state setter depends on its own state](useeffect-infinite-loop.md): Calling setState inside useEffect with that state in the dependency array creates an infinite re-render loop. HIGH.
- [setTimeout in useEffect without cleanup fires after unmount](settimeout-cleanup.md): setTimeout scheduled in useEffect fires even after unmount, updating stale state. Always return a cleanup function. MEDIUM.
- [base-ui Select shows the raw value in its collapsed trigger without an items prop](base-ui-select-items-prop-collapsed-trigger.md): Children-only SelectItem labels don't resolve before mount or for values missing from the mounted list, so the trigger silently shows raw enums/ids; always pass items={[{value,label}]} and resolve labels for stale values. MEDIUM.
- [Unmount flush resurrects localStorage state cleared by another component](unmount-flush-resurrects-cleared-state.md): An autosave hook's flush-on-unmount re-saves a draft another component just cleared (discard then navigate unmounts AFTER the clear); pair the external clear with an event that makes the flush a no-op. MEDIUM.
- [react-hooks/set-state-in-effect is an ERROR, breaking post-fetch state reconciliation](set-state-in-effect-is-an-error.md): Recent eslint-plugin-react-hooks presets ship the rule at error severity, so dropping stale optimistic overrides in an effect keyed on fetched data fails CI; move the reconciliation into the fetch callback, or return the identical state object so the no-op costs no render. MEDIUM.
